scheme_name: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
other_conditions: Must have a disability of at least 40%.
Must be pursuing first year or higher of professional courses after +2, including undergraduate, postgraduate, M.Phil, PhD, Law, Management, Medicine, and other technical courses.
benefits_summary: Laptops equipped with JAWS software are provided to eligible visually impaired students for higher education.
